thread:
jordan_partnerships: Big win — HelixGenomics is live on AWS Marketplace with our Dedicated offering! Pilot passed full load and inference accuracy checks, private VPC configured, and first paid commit signed. Massive thanks to @sam_integrations for the integration work, @maria_sales for co-sell support, and @alex_gtm for moving the contract. :tada: Case study + launch assets here: https://confluence.redwood/helix-marketplace-draft. Please react :sparkles: if you want this in the company newsletter.

maria_sales: Amazing news. Customer gave a short quote from their VP Eng: "Redwood made inference predictable for our genome pipelines without us redesigning infra." Can we get a 1-2 sentence blurb for press?

sam_integrations: Technical recap: we used the marketplace AMI + Helm chart, attached a VPC endpoint and dedicated GPU pool, and applied q4_onnx quantization for cost parity. Minimal network NAT tweak on their side. Deploy snippet we used: ```helm repo add redwood https://charts.redwood.ai && helm upgrade --install helix redwood/instance -f helm-values-helix.yaml``` Happy to publish the step-by-step.

alex_gtm: I'll spin up the co-sell playbook and PR draft. Need logo (SVG/PNG) and marketing-approved quote. @legal-bot can you confirm logo/mention rights?

legal-bot: MSA signed yesterday; Helix granted public mention and logo use. They requested a jointly authored PR next Tue but no strict embargo. Recommend coordinating final quote sign-off with their comms.

jordan_partnerships: Great — scheduling a 15m sync today 3:00pm PT to align messaging, PR, and case study owner. If you can't make it, please drop comments on the doc. Adding this to Partnerships wins board for Q2 highlight.

ci-bot: Autopost scheduled to #announcements on 2024-04-02 16:00 UTC pending PR approval.

maria_sales: :thumbsup:

sam_integrations: Nice work team :shipit:
